referenceFunction.generalComment: The data represents the airport in Zurich (uniqueairport). It has been assumed that after 100 years the entire construction material will be disposed. For the disposal a distance of 20 km has been applied. \n\n; UUID: 7a9564d5-2bc1-4594-a92d-6b67bf37c2ea
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The inventory includes the disposal of contaminated gravel. Transport from the airport to disposal and disposal are accounted for. The disposal of buildings are not accounted for, but included in the module "airport".
referenceFunction.name: Disposal, airport

geography.text: Data refers the conditions at the major airport in Switzerland.

timePeriod.text: The data represents the condition in the early 1990’ties. However, the data presented is adjusted by a factor of 1.5 to represent current conditions.

representativeness.uncertaintyAdjustments: Data from one airport in Switzerland is used as an estimate for Europe
